title: Walmart Shoplifting Duo Get Busted After Thinking They Can Flee Police
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On February 25th, 2022. Walmart employees noticed a woman who had been previously trespassed, stealing and concealing a bunch of items. When the employees & officers tried to stop her, she got in a vehicle with her accomplice and immediately fled the scene. Officers eventually caught up to the girls & the main shoplifter said the officer was attacking her and she didn’t know what to do so she fled the scene. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
